name: Small modular reactors
principle: Reactors generally 300 MWe or less (microreactors under 20 MWe), built in factories and installed in modules. The World Nuclear Association page read names project Pele (1 to 10 MWe, TRISO fuel completed November 2025) but does not describe NuScale, BWRX-300 or Rolls-Royce SMR.

process_steps.name: Steam or heat to turbine, process or desalination

source.note: IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, dataset of 24 July 2026, latest assessment (IEA 1-11 scale): 'Water-cooled SMR' 7 (2025)

sources.note: World Nuclear Association, Small nuclear power reactors
Wikipedia: Small modular reactor — process-description cross-check 2026-10-29 (secondary source)

reference_plants.name: Darlington BWRX-300, Ontario (OPG / GE Hitachi)
reference_plants.capacity: 300 MWe BWRX-300; OPG received construction approval April 2025 - first grid-scale SMR under construction in a G7 country; CAD 7.7 bn project

source.note: SMR Brief project tracker (construction approval Apr 2025, CAD 7.7 bn); ANS Nuclear Newswire, Oct 2026 (under construction); NuScale status: NRC design certification 2023, but the first proposed US project (UAMPS Carbon Free Power Project) was cancelled Nov 2023; UK SMR competition narrowed to four contenders Sep 2024; read 2026-10-28
